description: Fetch full event detail by OCD event ID. Returns agenda, participants, media links, and associated documents when requested via include. Experimental — event coverage is limited in Open States. Obtain the event_id from openstates_search_events.

include.description: Related data to inline. "agenda" and "participants" are most useful; "links", "media", and "documents" add related URLs, recordings, and files, and "sources" the provenance URLs behind the record.

name: openstates_get_event

agenda.description: Agenda items when include=agenda is requested.

documents.description: Document links when include=documents is requested.

note.description: Document description. Empty string when Open States recorded no description.

end_date.description: Event end datetime. Absent when not recorded.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: Event ID does not exist in Open States. `upstream_timeout`: Open States did not answer within the per-request timeout. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

links.description: Event links when include=links is requested.

note.description: Link description. Empty string when Open States recorded no description.

media.description: Media links when include=media is requested.

note.description: Media description. Empty string when Open States recorded no description.

role.description: Participant role. Absent when upstream omits it.

sources.description: Provenance sources when include=sources is requested.

note.description: Source note. Empty string when Open States recorded no note.

title: Get Event
